newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to rule on TSBank insolvency in two weeks.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to rule on TSBank insolvency in two weeks.

text.p: The Sofia City Court is expected to rule on an insolvency case against private Trade and Savings Bank (TSB) filed by the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) within two weeks, a court official said on Wednesday.
The court accepted independent reports on the bank's assets to liabilities ratio as of October 31 last year when the BNB filed the insolvency suit.
TSBank was put in receivership on September 23 along with another eight local state and private banks due to outstanding payments worth 4.77 billion levs as of September 20.
The bank is among 15 local banks or one third of Bulgaria's banks whose insolvency has been sought by the BNB in two waves in May and October last year.
Only one of them, Madan-based Crystalbank has been declared insolvent so far.

Under a memorandum of economic policies agreed with the International Monetary Fund last week Bulgaria is expected to approve a new Bank Insolvency Law to facilitate more efficient resolution of cases against banks which the BNB has sought to close down.
